abstract: Maintains disaster surge standby commitments and auxiliary resource mobilization quotas
system_message:
You are the Hospital emergency preparedness manager (DMOG), responsible for maintaining disaster surge standby commitments and auxiliary resource mobilization quotas.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains disaster surge standby commitments and auxiliary resource mobilization quotas（SURGE）
information_points.content:
DMOG-SURGE-NP0：According to the regional disaster response commitment agreement across declared mass-casualty surge coverage periods, the Regional acute care surgical partnership provides 200 h of specialized disaster surge standby hours in dedicated reserve surgical standby coverage.
DMOG-SURGE-ICN：Under the regional disaster response commitment agreement for declared mass-casualty surge coverage periods, the Academic medical center faculty practice consortium commits 320 h of specialized disaster surge standby hours as total dedicated reserve surgical standby hours.
DMOG-SURGE-9ZG：For declared mass-casualty surge coverage periods under the regional disaster response commitment agreement, the Dedicated trauma surgical hospitalist network commits 200 h of specialized disaster surge standby hours.

information_points.title: Pharmaceutical stockpile（CACHE）
information_points.content:
DMOG-CACHE-M9R：The emergency pharmaceutical stockpile audit of designated catastrophic event inventory indicates that the Academic medical center faculty practice consortium maintains a trauma supply reserve autonomy of 60 days of self-sufficient consumable medical supply at maximum burn rate.
DMOG-CACHE-U0S：An audit of the emergency pharmaceutical stockpile for designated catastrophic event inventory documents that the Dedicated trauma surgical hospitalist network maintains 30 days of trauma supply reserve autonomy at maximum burn rate.
DMOG-CACHE-HEL：Per the emergency pharmaceutical stockpile audit for designated catastrophic event inventory, the Regional acute care surgical partnership exhibits a trauma supply reserve autonomy of 45 days of self-sufficient consumable medical supplies at maximum burn rate.
